# MR. Property

> Luxury real estate consultancy offering curated homes, villas, and investment properties in Istanbul, Bodrum, and Dubai — with Turkish citizenship-by-investment guidance.

MR. Property helps international buyers find, evaluate, and purchase premium residential and investment property across Türkiye (Istanbul, Bodrum) and the UAE (Dubai). We provide end-to-end advisory, from shortlisting to closing, including Turkish citizenship eligibility through qualifying real estate investment (minimum $400,000 USD).
